authors: research session (subagent of the main session); frozen before any measured data
question: Does the twisted all-lift line u.F_q lower the complete, verified, cold end-to-end index-calculus cost (relations, linear algebra, discrete log) against the standard base F_q on the same one-target workloads, in ecbench's counted unit, and what is each arm's distance to the matched strong rho?

claims.text: Paired totals ratio S(ic-tw-a)/S(ic-std) over all (workload, round) pairs at m = 5, with its paired bootstrap 95% interval, at every weight w in {0, 0.1, 1} of the section 5a band.
claims.if_supported: An end-to-end pipeline improvement of the twisted line over the standard base at m = 5 (stage 2 extends it to m = 7).
claims.if_not_supported: A tie or a loss is the result and is reported as such; the per-trial yield gain does not carry end to end.

claims.text: Each IC arm's distance to the matched rho: S(arm)/S(rho_ref) with rho_ref the cheaper (lower Sigma S) of rho-strong-l1 and rho-strong-l16, at each w of the band.
claims.if_supported: Distance remaining reported per arm; not a gate.

claims.text: Noise floors: construction A/A (ic-tw-b against ic-tw-a, C-aa-line) and wall A/A (ic-tw-a-aa against ic-tw-a, C-aa-wall) are reported beside C1; C1 counts only if its interval excludes the line-A/A interval.

hypotheses.statement: At toy size the relation phase dominates; the twisted line needs about twice the relations (columns q-1 against about q/2) but each trial yields a relation with probability about 0.5-0.75 against about 0.08, at an unchanged per-trial solve cost, so the end-to-end S ratio twisted/standard is below 1.
hypotheses.mechanism: Yield identity (2Q-2)^4/(Q-2)^4 about 16 per trial (PR #2704), per-trial cost ratio 0.961, 2LP cost-model prediction 2^-0.5 at scale (PR #2686/#2704 model); at toy size linear algebra is negligible, so the derived toy prediction is lower than 2^-0.5.

predictions.minimum_effect: upper end of the paired 95% interval below 1 at w = 0, 0.1 and 1; predicted point value in [0.1, 0.71]

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Development smoke 2026-11-08 on the preparing container (4 vCPU, shared with other agents, L0, --cpus none), m = 5, target_seed 99 (not a frozen target), one workload, rounds 1, all runs verified and replayed identically. Session wall: std dispatch 56 s per workload-round (ic-std 57.7 s per execution: 199 trials, 13 relations, 15 columns), tw dispatch 49 s per workload-round (ic-tw-a 17.5 s / 59 trials / 32 relations, ic-tw-b 13.5 s / 43 trials, ic-tw-a-aa 18.6 s); rho arms under 1 ms. Projection for 6 workloads x (5 + 1 warm-up) rounds: std about 2020 s, tw about 1760 s, total about 3780 s in two dispatches, each below the 2700 s rule-1 threshold. One workload only: trial counts vary by target, so this is an estimate, not a bound.

stopping_rules.rule: Rule 1 (satisfied 2026-11-08 before freezing): the xline_bin unit tests passed, a development smoke per IC arm verified and replayed, and its timing projected the single-session stage 1 above 2700 s; the stage is therefore run as the two dispatches std and tw of the same workloads, seeds and rounds (5 measured + 1 warm-up), never fewer targets or rounds. If a dispatch hits its 3600 s deadline, its session is kept as censored evidence and the stage is reported incomplete; it is not rerun smaller.

Stage 2 (m = 7 std and tw specs) runs only if stage 1 completes and its measured per-execution times, scaled by the m = 7 smoke of each IC arm, project each m = 7 dispatch below 2700 s; otherwise stage 2 is recorded as not run.
Total spend USD 10 including build, failed and interrupted attempts; stop new launches when reached or unknown.
Any wrong_answer, exhausted or timeout run is kept; a comparison containing one is incomplete and decides nothing.

invalidation_rules: Audit not OK or any replay not identical: no result.
A run from another commit, image or spec hash: inadmissible.
Changing the oracle, line seeds, curves, targets, seeds, unit or accounting after any measured data.

decision_rule.text: Primary: ecbench compare --dir STD --a ic-std --b ic-tw-a --b-dir TW --weight w for w in {0, 0.1, 1} (operations, cross-session, paired by (workload, round) seed), over all pairs at m = 5. Twisted is an end-to-end improvement iff the paired 95% interval's upper end is below 1 at all three weights and the line A/A (ic-tw-b / ic-tw-a) interval contains 1, or the C1 interval excludes the line A/A interval; a regression iff the lower end is above 1 at all three weights; otherwise unresolved (tie); any unverified run makes it incomplete. The matched rho at each weight is whichever of rho-strong-l1 and rho-strong-l16 has the lower total priced S at that weight in the same session as the IC arm; gap to rho is S(arm)/S(rho_ref) per weight, reported as distance remaining, not a gate. The two decision comparisons (C-tw-vs-std-m5, C-gap-rho-m5) are read with Holm's correction at family alpha 0.05; the A/A comparisons set noise floors and decide nothing. Wall time is compared within a session only.
decision_rule.threshold: 95% paired bootstrap interval vs 1 across the band
decision_rule.statistic: paired totals ratio Sigma S_B / Sigma S_A over (workload, round) pairs (ecbench compare)
decision_rule.interval: paired bootstrap 95% (ecbench compare), at each band weight w in {0, 0.1, 1}
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ratio of totals, with log2 of the ratio

inputs: the std and tw session directories of one stage
outputs: audit receipts (verify --replay-all), saved comparisons at w = 0, 0.1, 1, tables

graphs: S per arm per workload with rho band; ratio with interval across w

inadmissible: Reporting the per-trial yield gain as an end-to-end improvement
Using wall time below L2 or inside the A/A interval as a result
Shrinking targets or rounds to fit a deadline
